scope: Local Codex user directory; project and plugin copies preserved
verification: Manifest existence, unique canonical name and SHA-256 checked; scripts and runtime dependencies not executed

pre_install_check.method: Local static pattern scanner on 10 package trees and 12 skill directories, followed by manual triage of flagged locations
triage: Package-root missing-SKILL warnings reflect plugins containing nested skill directories.
Security examples, rejected-command test vectors and syntax-only compile tests were pattern false positives.
Zero-width characters were Markdown fence formatting and emoji joiners.
Recursive deletion targets temporary directories created by the validation runner.
HTTP request helper supports advisory queries, including dependency names/versions sent to OSV.
pre_install_check.limits: No full security certification, live advisory lookup, scanner runtime or patch-validation workflow was performed.
